question: For each room, list its associated building name, floor number, room number, ownership type, organization name, number of rooms, area, and percentage of area relative to the building. Include subtotals across floors, subtotals across all floors for each building, and a grand total across all buildings. For the subtotal for each building and the grand total, the percentage of area should be relative to area of all buildings. All numeric values should be rounded to integers and formatted using commas as thousands separators except the relative percentages which should be rounded to two decimal places.

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE rooms_with_building AS
SELECT
  r.building_key,
  r.floor,
  r.room,
  r.area,
  r.organization_name,
  b.ownership_type,
  b.building_name_long
FROM beaver."fac_rooms" AS r
LEFT JOIN beaver."fac_building" AS b
  ON r.building_key = b.fac_building_key

FROM beaver."fac_rooms" AS r

SELECT

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "rooms_with_building" AS SELECT 
  building_key AS BUILDING_KEY,
  floor AS FLOOR,
  room AS ROOM,
  area AS AREA,
  organization_name AS ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  ownership_type AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
  building_name_long AS BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
  'BUILDING_KEY,FLOOR,ROOM,AREA,ORGANIZATION_NAME,OWNERSHIP_TYPE,BUILDING_NAME_LONG' AS columns
FROM rooms_with_building

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH room_base AS (
    SELECT 
        building_name_long AS building_name,
        ownership_type,
        floor,
        room,
        organization_name,
        CAST(area AS DOUBLE) AS area
    FROM rooms_with_building
    WHERE area IS NOT NULL
),
building_totals AS (
    SELECT building_name, SUM(area) AS building_area
    FROM room_base
    GROUP BY building_name
),
-- room-level rows with pct of building
room_rows AS (
    SELECT 
        rb.building_name,
        rb.floor,
        rb.room,
        rb.ownership_type,
        rb.organization_name,
        1::DOUBLE AS number_of_rooms,
        rb.area AS area_sqft,
        CASE WHEN bt.building_area>0 THEN (rb.area/bt.building_area)*100 ELSE NULL END AS pct_area_building
    FROM room_base rb
    JOIN building_totals bt USING (building_name)
),
-- floor subtotals within building (pct relative to building)
floor_subtotals AS (
    SELECT 
        building_name,
        floor,
        'Subtotal' AS room,
        ANY_VALUE(ownership_type) AS ownership_type,
        '—' AS organization_name,
        CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) AS number_of_rooms,
        SUM(area_sqft) AS area_sqft,
        NULL::DOUBLE AS pct_area_building
    FROM room_rows
    GROUP BY building_name, floor
),
-- building subtotals (pct relative to grand total across all buildings)
building_subtotals AS (
    SELECT 
        building_name,
        NULL AS floor,
        'Building subtotal' AS room,
        ANY_VALUE(ownership_type) AS ownership_type,
        '—' AS organization_name,
        CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) AS number_of_rooms,
        SUM(area_sqft) AS area_sqft
    FROM room_rows
    GROUP BY building_name
),
-- grand area for percentages of building subtotals and grand total
all_building_area AS (
    SELECT SUM(building_area) AS grand_area FROM building_totals
),
-- Assemble room + floor subtotal rows with pct relative to building
room_and_floor AS (
    SELECT 
        rr.building_name,
        rr.floor,
        rr.room,
        rr.ownership_type,
        rr.organization_name,
        rr.number_of_rooms,
        rr.area_sqft,
        CASE 
          WHEN rr.room='Subtotal' THEN (rr.area_sqft/bt.building_area)*100
          ELSE rr.pct_area_building
        END AS pct_area
    FROM (
      SELECT * FROM room_rows
      UNION ALL
      SELECT * FROM floor_subtotals
    ) rr
    JOIN building_totals bt USING (building_name)
),
-- Building subtotal rows with pct relative to all buildings
building_rows AS (
    SELECT 
        bs.building_name,
        bs.floor,
        bs.room,
        bs.ownership_type,
        bs.organization_name,
        bs.number_of_rooms,
        bs.area_sqft,
        CASE WHEN ga.grand_area>0 THEN (bs.area_sqft/ga.grand_area)*100 ELSE NULL END AS pct_area
    FROM building_subtotals bs
    CROSS JOIN all_building_area ga
),
-- Grand total row
grand_row AS (
    SELECT 
        NULL AS building_name,
        NULL AS floor,
        'Grand total' AS room,
        ANY_VALUE(ownership_type) AS ownership_type,
        '—' AS organization_name,
        CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) AS number_of_rooms,
        SUM(area_sqft) AS area_sqft,
        100.0 AS pct_area
    FROM room_rows
),
-- Union all rows
unioned AS (
    SELECT * FROM room_and_floor
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM building_rows
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM grand_row
),
-- Final formatting
final AS (
    SELECT 
        building_name AS building_name,
        floor AS floor_number,
        room AS room_number,
        ownership_type,
        organization_name,
        REPLACE(CAST(ROUND(number_of_rooms,0) AS VARCHAR), '.0','') AS number_of_rooms,
        FORMAT('{:,}', ROUND(area_sqft,0)) AS area,
        ROUND(pct_area,2) AS pct_area_of_building
    FROM unioned
)
SELECT * FROM final
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN room_number='Building subtotal' THEN 2 WHEN room_number='Subtotal' THEN 1 WHEN room_number='Grand total' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END,
  building_name NULLS FIRST,
  floor_number NULLS FIRST,
  room_number
